1. Verify the Page Component file to use as the popup screen's source (src).  
    (This example uses the page_component.xml file.)  
2. Review the methods added to that Page Component.  
3. Click the $p.openPopup() button contained within the PageFrame at the bottom.
4. Verify that the PageFrame popup is created.
5. Click each of the four buttons at the bottom.
6. Confirm that you can directly execute the methods of the Page Component contained within the popup from the main screen.
(Detailed scripts can be found in the Script tab.)
